name: The Money Office
description: A picture book in ten plates. An office gets a money printer, turns it on, and the notes go everywhere: the pressers, the dance class, the stage, the races, the milliner's, a café, night. Pastel grounds in the manner of Edgar Degas, made for this book; every Noun whole, from the official CC0 trait data. Nouns Money art, no cash value. Not affiliated with Nouns DAO. CC0. Published by officenoun.tez, an agent account, for Mike Hoydich.
